tasks.spec:
You are building a bounded billed-probe harness on freytag-forge (Python 3.12). Working directory: /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge. You may create ONLY the files listed as owned: scripts/ringer/stage7/three_c_probe.py, check_three_c_probe.py, test_three_c_probe.py (same dir), bench/variations/stage7-3c-control.json and stage7-3c-pre667.json, and output under bench/results/stage7-3c-dry/. Never edit data/, src/, other tests, other stage7 scripts, git state, or .env; never print credentials. NO billed or network call while building: only --dry-run and hermetic tests. No uv: use `cd /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge && export PYTHONPATH=/home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge TMPDIR=/tmp` and `.venv/bin/python`.

PURPOSE (Scene 3C of the Continuity Initiative, plan .plans/chatgpt-3c-stuck-turns-plan.md Step 1): measure whether a raw blind player, starting FRESH at the 3C scene entry, reaches the earned ending, comparing arm `control` (current package) against arm `pre667` (same package with the four PR 667 d_r1 verb phrases removed). Model your code on scripts/ringer/stage7/door_probe.py (read it, plus door_continuation.py, door_transport.py, door_ask_player.mjs, check_door_probe.py, bench/core.py package_and_state/load_variation/provider_for). Reuse SpendBudget, counted_provider, RawRequestError from door_transport and the _ask_player pattern (node door_ask_player.mjs, raw profile) rather than reimplementing them; import from door_probe only if it does not run code at import time, otherwise copy the small function.

VARIATIONS: create bench/variations/stage7-3c-control.json = {"name":"stage7-3c-control","story_package":"data/stories/continuity-initiative","overrides":{}} and stage7-3c-pre667.json with the same plus overrides.knowledge.yaml.replacements = [{"old": ", broadcasting the reports, broadcasting reports, relay the reports, relaying the reports]", "new": "]"}] (copy the exact format used by bench/variations/stage7-door-*.json; the replacement must match EXACTLY ONCE in data/stories/continuity-initiative/knowledge.yaml and the harness must fail loudly otherwise; verify it loads with load_variation/package_and_state and that the pre667 arm's k_sl_3c_d_r1 action_evidence lacks those four phrases while control has them).

HARNESS three_c_probe.py CLI: --n (1 or 12 rows per arm), --out DIR, --dry-run, --confirm (required for any billed call; without it or with --dry-run no network), --semantic {on,off} default off (record in the output; when off set provider.semantic_ask = None like door_probe does). Caps: n=1: 80 cloudflare requests and 40 raw-player attempts in total; n=12: 960 and 480. SpendBudget enforces them; on any cap/quota/malformed error stop, write run-failure.txt with the verbatim error, never retry or replace a row. Arms interleave (control, pre667, control, ...) per row.

ONE ROW = one fresh game: build state with package_and_state(variation, '3C'), provider_for, RuntimeEngine as door_probe does. Loop: screen text = the 3C entry text then the latest narration reply (same transcript style door_probe uses); ask the raw player for a command; run engine.turn(command); record per attempt: command, engine status (accepted / rejected / clarification — derive as door_continuation.score_command does), committed reveal ids, story-fact delta, cue text staged, response text, and `deadline_event_ids` if the turn record exposes them (engine.py around the resolution deadline backstop; grep 'deadline'). Stop the row at story_complete, at 14 ACCEPTED scene turns plus the turn that triggers the deadline, or at 20 attempts, whichever first. Never judge by narration text; classify only from engine data.

PER-ROW OUTCOME (store as `outcome`): `earned_complete` if story_complete AND the committed reveals include d_r1 and d_r2 and one of e_r1/e_r2 and the chain a, b, both c parts were committed by player turns AND no deadline_event_ids were recorded; `deadline_complete` if story_complete but any link was supplied by the deadline backstop or deadline ids are non-empty or provenance cannot be established (mark unknown, never earned); `no_complete` otherwise. Also record per row: accepted_turns, attempts, rejections, clarifications, committed reveal ids in order, whether d_r1 was committed and on which scene turn.

OUTPUT under --out: source.json (variation file hashes and the knowledge.yaml replacement proof), spend.json (budget events, caps), rows.json (all rows), summary.json (per arm counts of the three outcomes, mean accepted turns, d_r1 commit rate; no statistics claims), prompts/ is not needed. --dry-run must write source.json plus a plan.json listing the interleaved row order and caps, with zero model calls, and exit 0.

Also write check_three_c_probe.py OUT_DIR N --mode {dry,artifacts}: dry validates source/plan (replacement matched once, caps, 2N rows interleaved); artifacts validates rows/spend/summary reconcile (spend events within caps, every row has an outcome from the three allowed values, summary counts equal row counts, a run-failure.txt means exit nonzero unless rows are complete); every failure prints WHY.

Write test_three_c_probe.py (pytest, hermetic, fake provider and fake player, no network) covering: the outcome classifier (earned vs deadline vs unknown provenance vs no_complete), the stop rules (14 accepted turns, 20 attempts, story_complete), interleaving, and the exactly-once replacement failure. Run: `.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q scripts/ringer/stage7/test_three_c_probe.py`, then `.venv/bin/python scripts/ringer/stage7/three_c_probe.py --n 1 --dry-run --out bench/results/stage7-3c-dry` and `.venv/bin/python scripts/ringer/stage7/check_three_c_probe.py bench/results/stage7-3c-dry 1 --mode dry`. Then `.venv/bin/ruff format` and `.venv/bin/ruff check` on your three .py files. Match surrounding code style.
tasks.check: cd /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge && export PYTHONPATH=/home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge TMPDIR=/tmp && .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q scripts/ringer/stage7/test_three_c_probe.py 2>&1 | tail -8 && rm -rf bench/results/stage7-3c-dry && .venv/bin/python scripts/ringer/stage7/three_c_probe.py --n 1 --dry-run --out bench/results/stage7-3c-dry && .venv/bin/python scripts/ringer/stage7/check_three_c_probe.py bench/results/stage7-3c-dry 1 --mode dry && .venv/bin/ruff check scripts/ringer/stage7/three_c_probe.py scripts/ringer/stage7/check_three_c_probe.py scripts/ringer/stage7/test_three_c_probe.py && test -z "$(git status --porcelain data src)"
